name: ios-service-retirement
goal: Wait for shared Xcode helpers from reused services without granting signal authority

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An isolated native run passed three build assertions but retained a protected IBAgent-iOS helper. Wait for attested service descendants without granting signal authority.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: 697023c verification cce2142d failed native-build process settlement despite three passing assertions. Mock observer and reused-service regressions reproduced unreadable/late helper failures.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Add bounded single-flight observation of existing attested services, retaining private-process settlement and refusing unreadable authority. Observed services are never signalled.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: 18 retirement, observation and reused-service tests pass, including a protected helper that retires after 35 seconds: /tmp/harness-ios-retirement-complete-root-green.log. Actual native verification remains pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
